CONFIGURATION GUIDES

One connection, in your environment.

01Python SDK+
WHERE IT RUNS

A server-side Python application.

CONFIGURE

Load your account key, endpoint and exact model ID from environment variables. Initialize your client once and send the request from your backend.

VERIFY

Handle exceptions at the application boundary and record a request identifier for investigation.

Open the matching guide →
02JavaScript SDK+
WHERE IT RUNS

A server-side Node.js application.

CONFIGURE

Configure the client with your account endpoint and key. Keep secrets out of code bundled for the browser.

VERIFY

Return only the content your frontend needs. Set an application timeout and handle rejected requests.

Open the matching guide →
03cURL / HTTP+
WHERE IT RUNS

A direct request from a terminal or server.

CONFIGURE

Attach the bearer credential and Content-Type header, then send a JSON body that matches the selected model schema.

VERIFY

Inspect both HTTP status and response body. Do not paste a live credential into shared logs.

Open the matching guide →
04Automation workflows+
WHERE IT RUNS

An HTTP request step in your workflow builder.

CONFIGURE

Use the platform’s credential mechanism for authorization, map your workflow inputs into the request body, and validate the response.

VERIFY

Keep the returned job ID for asynchronous requests. Avoid restarting a generation every time a workflow polls.

Open the matching guide →
05App builders+
WHERE IT RUNS

A builder that supports custom model endpoints.

CONFIGURE

Check that the builder accepts the account endpoint, model ID and authentication format. Confirm the specific modality is supported.

VERIFY

A text-model integration does not automatically support image or video request schemas.

Open the matching guide →
06Custom applications+
WHERE IT RUNS

Your own backend and application flow.

CONFIGURE

Separate the provider connection from your product logic. Store model configuration alongside the version of your workflow.

VERIFY

Define fallback behavior at the task level and compare results before changing models.

Open the matching guide →
